note: The Central Bank of Seychelles' comparison of the banks' charges, applicable from 1 October to 31 December 2026: Absa's classic credit card costs 100 rupees a year, with interest of 33% a year on the unpaid balance; the Mauritius Commercial Bank's VISA Classic costs 100 rupees a year for the primary card, with interest of 16% a year on the unpaid balance. Their subscription or issue fees aren't counted. Al Salam Bank's credit card (1.5% a month, 500 rupees a year) isn't kept, the table naming no card; the other banks offer none.
